newsitem.title: INDIA: India gold ends down on new supplies, silver slips.
newsitem.headline: India gold ends down on new supplies, silver slips.

text.p: Gold prices ended lower on Tuesday on the back of weak trend in the world market and fresh arrival of stocks, dealers said.

Physical buying was low and the sentiment was subdued at the close of the session, they said. Gold biscuit (116.50 gramme) settled 350 rupees lower at 59,750 rupees per piece. They were down by 200 rupees per piece during last week.
Silver opened lower on the back of setback in the world market but held steady at that level during the day on limited supplies and stray industrial support.
Silver was down by 40 rupees per kg during last week.
